description: AMSYOS: at start, a newer amsyos installed when one is out (at most one check a day, silent otherwise), the project's brief from the last sync written into the skill's brief.md and refreshed in the background; on a prompt, at most once a minute, what others in the workspace did that this project was not told yet (at most 5 lines, nothing on any error); before compaction, a checkpoint of open work; before the turn ends, a hold while a background task of this run (amsyos bg start) ended unread or is quiet, overdue or lost (until it is looked at, at most twice a state, never for a task that runs well), or a check set for later in this project is due (amsyos later). Deterministic, no model, quiet, within 3 s.
